_doc: Local snapshot of Agnes AI official model availability. Used by check_official_docs.py as the diff baseline. The /v1/models endpoint is authoritative; per-model doc pages under doc_base_* are a secondary signal (slug = model_id without dots). Update this when official docs change.
_slug_rule: Per-model doc URL = doc_base_<lang> + '/' + model_id.replace('.', ''). e.g. agnes-image-2.1-flash -> agnes-image-21-flash
